title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals adopt and comply with mask-wearing over time under the influence of social networks, policies, information campaigns, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: People influence each other’s mask attitudes and adoption through social network contacts and observed behaviors in shared locations.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations enforce mask policies; HealthAuthority conducts inspections and issues penalties, affecting compliance probability.

interactions.name: information_diffusion
interactions.description: HealthAuthority and MediaOutlet broadcast messages that update individual risk perceptions and mask attitudes based on credibility and susceptibility.

interactions.name: retail_purchase
interactions.description: People purchase masks from retailers subject to inventory, price, and rationing; access influences future adoption.

interactions.name: attendance_and_observation
interactions.description: People visit locations; they observe the share of others wearing masks, reinforcing norms and affecting subsequent decisions.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Share of people wearing masks in public at each time step.

metrics.name: adoption_by_location_type
metrics.description: Mask-wearing rates segmented by location type (e.g., workplace, transit, retail).

metrics.name: compliance_rate_under_mandate
metrics.description: Fraction of people complying with mask requirements when mandates are in place.

metrics.name: time_to_reach_70_percent
metrics.description: Number of days until overall adoption rate first reaches 70%.

metrics.name: inventory_stockout_days
metrics.description: Number of days with mask stockouts at retailers (any retailer inventory at zero).

metrics.name: average_masks_purchased_per_person
metrics.description: Mean number of masks purchased per person over the simulation horizon.

metrics.name: inequality_index_of_adoption
metrics.description: Gini or similar index measuring disparities in adoption across income groups.

metrics.name: policy_violations_per_day
metrics.description: Count of non-compliant entries to locations with mandates per day.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_stability
metrics.description: Variance of adoption rate over the last 7 days; lower indicates stabilization.
